source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder in contemporary Bokmål (2005 norm); not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". Subordinate clauses with "når" and "hvis" (the verb comes after the subject and the sentence adverb: "hvis du ikke forstår").

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Lars er lærer. Han har en klasse med tjue elever. Nils er i klassen.
sentences.english: Lars is a teacher. He has a class of twenty pupils. Nils is in the class.

sentences.text: Hver morgen er Lars i klassen. Når skolen begynner, sier elevene: «God morgen!»
sentences.english: Every morning Lars is in the classroom. When school begins, the pupils say: "Good morning!"

sentences.text: I dag leser klassen om Norge. Lars har mange spørsmål.
sentences.english: Today the class reads about Norway. Lars has many questions.

sentences.text: Hvor ligger Bergen?
sentences.english: Where is Bergen?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Bergen ligger i vest!
sentences.english: Bergen is in the west!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Bra! Hva er en fjord?
sentences.english: Good! What is a fjord?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg forstår ikke spørsmålet. Det er vanskelig.
sentences.english: I do not understand the question. It is difficult.
sentences.speaker: elev

sentences.text: Hvis du ikke forstår, kan du spørre. Det er ikke vanskelig å spørre.
sentences.english: If you do not understand, you can ask. It is not difficult to ask.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Er en fjord havet i fjellet?
sentences.english: Is a fjord the sea in the mountains?
sentences.speaker: elev

sentences.text: Ja, du forstår! Når du leser om Norge, vet du mer.
sentences.english: Yes, you understand! When you read about Norway, you know more.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: I morgen er det en prøve. Elevene liker ikke prøver.
sentences.english: Tomorrow there is a test. The pupils do not like tests.

sentences.text: Er prøven vanskelig, Lars?
sentences.english: Is the test difficult, Lars?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Nei, den er lett. Hvis du leser, er den lett.
sentences.english: No, it is easy. If you read, it is easy.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg leser hjemme hos Marta. Hun hjelper meg.
sentences.english: I read at home at Marta's. She helps me.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Det er bra. Spør Marta, hvis du vil.
sentences.english: That is good. Ask Marta, if you want.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Klokka to er skolen slutt. Elevene går hjem.
sentences.english: At two o'clock school is over. The pupils go home.

sentences.text: Når Lars kommer hjem, er han trøtt. Han drikker kaffe.
sentences.english: When Lars comes home, he is tired. He drinks coffee.

sentences.text: Hvordan var dagen?
sentences.english: How was the day?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Den var bra. Elevene vet mer hver uke.
sentences.english: It was good. The pupils know more every week.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Er elevene snille?
sentences.english: Are the pupils kind?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, jeg liker elevene, og jeg liker spørsmålene.
sentences.english: Yes, I like the pupils, and I like the questions.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Nils er hos Marta etter skolen. Han leser, og hun lager middag.
sentences.english: Nils is at Marta's after school. He reads, and she makes dinner.

sentences.text: Hva leser du, Nils?
sentences.english: What are you reading, Nils?
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg leser om fjorder. Jeg liker fjorder, men jeg liker ikke prøver.
sentences.english: I am reading about fjords. I like fjords, but I do not like tests.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Du er glad i bøker, Nils. Det er bra.
sentences.english: You are fond of books, Nils. That is good.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Ja, og jeg er glad i kake og brød også!
sentences.english: Yes, and I am fond of cake and bread too!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Lars svarer på en melding fra Sam. Han har ikke tid i dag. Han vil ringe i morgen, og så har de en plan.
sentences.english: Lars answers a message from Sam. He does not have time today. He will call tomorrow, and then they have a plan.

sentences.text: Kjære mamma, jeg skriver et brev i dag. Jeg savner deg, og jeg håper du svarer snart. Hilsen Sam
sentences.english: Dear Mum, I am writing a letter today. I miss you, and I hope you answer soon. Greetings, Sam

sentences.text: Flyet kom til Bergen, og Sam gikk ut.
sentences.english: The plane arrived in Bergen, and Sam went out.
